title: Squaring the Lot Premium Deposit with Homesite Reservation Credits on a Home Purchase Agreement
content:
**Escrow memo.** The lot premium deposit on a Home Purchase Agreement is squared when replacement funds for a returned deposit payment are figured.

**Amount owed.** The lot premium deposit owed is the converted Homesite Reservation class's lot premium deposit percentage at contract, applied to the agreement's lot premium and rounded half up to the cent, less the premium holding fee and extension fees the Homesite Reservation ledger shows applied to the agreement. It is zero where the agreement has no converted Homesite Reservation. The amount owed is that difference as it stands, with no floor.

**Amount held.** The lot premium deposit held is every lot premium deposit posted less every lot premium deposit returned unpaid.

**Squaring.**

- Where the held amount exceeds the amount owed, the buyer paid over reservation credits that had already reached the agreement, so the excess is credited against the replacement funds, but never by more than those applied reservation credits (the premium holding fee and extension fees applied); the rest stays with the non-refundable lot premium deposit.
- Where the held amount falls short of the amount owed, the whole shortfall is added to the replacement funds.
- Otherwise the replacement funds are not adjusted for the lot premium deposit.

## Truth table

| Held compared with owed | Reservation credits applied to the agreement | Effect on the replacement funds |
|---|---|---|
| Held exceeds owed | More than zero | Less the excess, capped at the applied credits |
| Held exceeds owed | None | Not adjusted |
| Held falls short of owed | Any | Plus the whole shortfall |
| Held equals owed | Any | Not adjusted |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Lot premium 40000.00; converted reservation class percentage 50; Homesite Reservation ledger shows a premium holding fee of 1500.00 and an extension fee of 500.00 applied to the agreement. Owed: 50 percent of 40000.00 is 20000.00, less 2000.00, so 18000.00.

| Lot premium deposits posted | Returned unpaid | Held | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20000.00 | 0.00 | 20000.00 | Excess 2000.00, within the 2000.00 credits: 2000.00 credited against the replacement funds |
| 21000.00 | 0.00 | 21000.00 | Excess 3000.00, capped at 2000.00: 2000.00 credited; 1000.00 stays with the lot premium deposit |
| 18000.00 | 18000.00 | 0.00 | Shortfall 18000.00 added to the replacement funds |
| 18000.00 | 0.00 | 18000.00 | Not adjusted |
